Proteasome-inhibitor class (degradation blockade) as a probe-derived recovery hypothesis
Client-binding pharmacological chaperone (ligand of the WWOX SDR domain)
ER-proteostasis regulators (IRE1/XBP1s arm activators, ERAD modulators)
Splice-correcting antisense oligonucleotide / editing for a splice-acceptor allele (TX-001)
AAV9-delivered human WWOX: endpoint families other than spike-wave discharges (survival, weight, glucose, motor score, gliosis, myelination)
A51, a multi-kinase inhibitor (Wnt/MYC suppression); BLOCK-1 open
Wnt-lowering (tankyrase-type) agents and GSK3 modulation as a downstream lever (TX-004)
Integrated-stress-response modulators (eIF2B activators of the ISRIB class, PERK-arm inhibitors, repurposed translational-repression reversers)
Ketogenic and lactate-transport interventions (the ketogenic diet; MCT1 blockade as a direction control)
Ketogenic diet (dietary intervention; composition and course not carried)
Pro-myelinating agents and the activity-dependent myelination sign problem
